notes.title: 🎉Banshee Update 1.2.6!🎉The nightmare doesn't end!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569022/bdfac11dbf5694573a442f6757b105ddad15b635.png"][/img][/p][p]🔧 Update contents[/p][p]🗺️ Map expansion:[/p][p]The ability to move outside the window and a garden have been added.[/p][p][/p][p]⚙️ Added optional items:[/p][p]The ability to adjust the viewing angle and volume has been added.[/p][p][/p][p]🏆 Steam achievements feature:[/p][p]Completing certain events will unlock achievements on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]🎬 New movie scene:[/p][p]A movie of the first encounter with a banshee has been added.[/p][p][/p][p]🐺 Added wolf as an enemy character:[/p][p]A ferocious wolf has been added that will attack the player.[/p][p][/p][p]The nightmare doesn't end - a new enemy, the "wolf," creeps into the dark night. Experience the latest update with enhanced Steam achievements and horror effects.[/p]

notes.title: 🎉Banshee Update 1.2.4🎉 Now with difficulty settings and multilingual support!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569022/0ef3e8eb6d0760234a6a44820b26059296e6378a.png[/img][h1]🔧Update contents[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]🕹️Added difficulty settings : [/b]  easy/normal/hard, which changes the Banshee's speed depending on the setting.
[*] [b]🧠Improved Banshee AI : [/b]  Prevents getting stuck and will only pull out if hiding extremely close.
[*] [b]🌍Multilingual support : [/b]  Supports three languages: English, Chinese (Simplified), and Japanese.
[*] [b]✋Improved item pickup : [/b]  Increased the interaction hit range.
[*] [b]🛠️Bug Fix : [/b]  Fixed an issue that could cause players to warp when hiding.
[/list]

[h2]🎮What about the future?[/h2]
Deeper and more thrilling.
Banshee will continue to evolve. Please look forward to its future developments.
